infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Flyer reads a screenshot of your class schedule so it can add your classes for you. You choose the image; nothing else in your library is accessed.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Flyer uses your location while the app is open to sort nearby places by walking time, and — only if you turn it on — to share where you are with friends you choose.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Flyer adds your classes and due dates to a separate Flyer calendar when you tap Export.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Flyer adds your classes and due dates to a separate Flyer calendar when you tap Export, and replaces them when you export again.
infoPlist.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: This lets ads in Flyer be more relevant. Saying no is fine — you'll still see ads, just less relevant ones. Your schedule, location, and friends are never shared with advertisers.
